proposal.diagnosis: The analysis shows that the program incorrectly adds the diagonal elements instead of multiplying them when calculating the determinant, especially when dealing with triangular matrices. In addition, there are issues with symbolic computation and submatrix construction, which have caused multiple test cases to fail.

causal_chain: Test Case input1 And input5 The failure of  indicates that the program incorrectly adds the diagonal elements when calculating a triangular matrix.
MR1、MR3 The failure indicates an error in the symbolic computation of the determinant.
AlgComp The loop in the method incorrectly skips some elements, resulting in an incorrect submatrix construction.

proposal.uncertainty: There may be other undetected errors, but the current repair candidates cover the known major issues.
proposal.assumption: Change the addition of diagonal elements to multiplication to correctly calculate the determinant of a triangular matrix.

edits.rationale: Change addition to multiplication to calculate the product of the diagonal elements.

proposal.expected_effect: Correct the calculation method for the determinant of a triangular matrix.
proposal.repair_intent: Corrected the calculation error in the determinant of a triangular matrix.
